user.title: Connect iCloud
user.description: Sign in with your Apple ID and an app-specific password (create one at appleid.apple.com → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords). Two-factor authentication must be enabled on the Apple ID.

data_description.apple_id: Your iCloud login, e.g. name@icloud.com, name@me.com or name@mac.com.
data_description.app_password: Format xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx. Never use your regular Apple ID password here.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate iCloud
reauth_confirm.description: iCloud rejected the stored app-specific password for {apple_id}. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach iCloud. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Apple rejected the credentials. Check the Apple ID and the app-specific password.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Apple ID is already configured.

tools.title: Tools and account
tools.description: Choose which tool groups are exposed and which write actions are allowed.

data.allow_delete: Allow deleting events, contacts, e-mails and notes
data.account_label: Account label (for tool names with several accounts)

data_description.account_label: Short name such as private or work. With more than one iCloud account the tools of further accounts get this as suffix, e.g. icloud_list_events_work. Default: local part of the Apple ID.

security.title: Security and guard rails
security.description: Quotas apply per account and sliding hour. Protected areas are read-only for AI clients; hidden mailboxes are not offered at all. Every writing action appears in the activity log of the “Frieda” panel and as the event friedafetch_action.

data.limit_mail_modify: Mail moves/deletions/flag changes per hour (0 = unlimited)
data.endpoint_admin_only: MCP endpoint only for administrator tokens

data_description.send_policy: “Any”: every address. “Contacts”: only addresses from the iCloud contacts or the allowlist. “Allowlist”: only the allowlist.
data_description.endpoint_admin_only: Applies to the whole endpoint /api/friedafetch as soon as one account demands it. For experiments use the read-only path /api/friedafetch/readonly.

data.rules_auto: Apply inbox rules automatically to new e-mails
data.rules_push: Push: apply the rules right after new mail arrives (IMAP IDLE)

approvals.title: Approvals (human in the loop)
approvals.description: Critical actions are not executed immediately but parked as an approval request: as a Home Assistant notification, optionally as a push with approve/deny buttons on your phone, and in the “Frieda” panel. After approval Home Assistant executes the action; the AI can query the outcome with icloud_approval_status.

data.approval_mass: Mail actions touching more than this many messages require approval (0 = off)

data_description.approval_notify: e.g. mobile_app_iphone – requires the Home Assistant companion app.

extras.title: Push, daily overview and attachments
extras.description: Daily overview: a short morning summary of unread e-mails, rule activity, today's events and birthdays. Attachments: folder for receipts and invoices stored by the tool or by inbox rules (must be an allowed path, e.g. /media/frieda).

data.digest_notify: Send the overview with (notify service; empty = notification in Home Assistant)
data.digest_ai_task: Phrase the overview with this AI task (optional)
data.attachments_dir: Attachment folder (empty = subfolder frieda in the media folder)

error.invalid_time: Please enter a time as HH:MM, e.g. 07:30.
error.path_not_allowed: Home Assistant does not allow writing to this folder. Use a media folder or add it to allowlist_external_dirs.

stale_copy.title: Extra copy of Frieda in custom_components

wrong_folder.title: Frieda is installed in the wrong folder
wrong_folder.description:
Frieda is loaded from {paths} instead of `{expected}`. This is usually a leftover `icloud_mcp` folder from before the rename; HACS updates of Frieda go to `{expected}` and stay hidden as long as this folder exists.

Reinstall Frieda via HACS (repository `{repository}`), then delete the folder listed above and restart Home Assistant.

send_digest.name: Send daily overview
send_digest.description: Sends the daily overview (unread e-mails, rule activity, today's events, birthdays) now.

account.name: Account
account.description: Label or Apple ID of the account (default: all accounts).
